profile.one_liner: Exa sells an AI-native web search API and deep research tools designed specifically to provide high-quality, semantically-relevant information to AI agents and large language models.
profile.capability_phrase: Web-scale crawling, proprietary search indexing, semantic embedding-based retrieval infrastructure, and GPU-accelerated model training for agent-optimized search.
churn_modes: Building and maintaining an in-house proprietary search index and retrieval system.
Switching to alternative AI-native search APIs like Tavily or other specialized retrieval providers.
Integrating search capabilities directly provided by large LLM platforms or cloud providers.
Reducing reliance on external search by using offline/local databases or private data sets.
profile.buyer_persona: Developers, AI companies, and enterprises building AI agents, chatbots, and research tools.
